additions.name: GreenSquare SYD1 Norwest — Stage 1
additions.site_identity_review: The operator places the refurbished original Stage 1 building at SYD1 in Norwest. The proponent places Stage 1 and the proposed Stage 2 buildings together on the campus at 3 Brookhollow Avenue. The existing NSW cadastral marker identifies the shared 5.2-hectare property.

locator.identity_review: The operator places the refurbished original Stage 1 building at SYD1 in Norwest. The proponent places Stage 1 and the proposed Stage 2 buildings together on the campus at 3 Brookhollow Avenue. The existing NSW cadastral marker identifies the shared 5.2-hectare property.

status.summary: On October 19, 2026, GreenSquare reported that Stage 1 of its SYD1 campus in Norwest was operating in the refurbished data centre building.

additions.distinctness_review: Snapshot 201 lists only the proposed Brookhollow Avenue expansion at this property. The operator identifies the existing converted facility as Stage 1, and the proponent identifies Buildings B, C and D as a separate Stage 2 proposal.
additions.successor_review: The October 19 operator release confirms Stage 1 operation. The October planning response distinguishes the existing building from Stage 2, which remained under assessment in November. The first customer’s November earnings disclosures cover the commissioning of its own deployments; they do not change the operator’s October facility observation.

additions.name: Evecon Lihula, proposed data-centre campus

status.summary: On September 15, the municipality reported that detailed planning for the proposed Lihula data centre had begun. The municipality had yet to receive a preliminary design.

locator.method: Area centroid of the five surveyed parcels in EPSG:3301, checked against their union and transformed to WGS 84.
locator.precision: Point representing the municipality’s 19.6-hectare data-centre planning area in Valuste.
locator.identity_review: The council order and municipal planning register identify the five properties in the Lihula proposal. The cadastral survey reproduces their names, village and combined area.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The point represents the whole proposed campus. The detailed plan will determine the positions of individual buildings.

additions.distinctness_review: The Lihula project occupies the five Valuste parcels in Order 287. The nearest baseline site is Risti Kampus, Rõuma, 38.1 km away. Evecon’s separate Risti proposal, the Northern Europe Energy Group proposal near Lihula and the adjacent Sipa battery project have different scopes.
additions.successor_review: In a November 21 interview, the developer and the municipality confirmed that detailed planning continued. The September municipal status record and later interview both describe planning; the municipality has not identified a construction start or granted building permit in the reviewed documents.

additions.name: Ilkari ILK-COL1, Tocancipá

status.summary: Ilkari reported that it operates one data center in Colombia and offers colocation services.

locator.method: Centroid computed from the IGAC WGS84 cadastral polygon, checked against the projected geometry.
locator.precision: Representative point for the commercial host parcel in the Tocancipá Free Trade Zone.
locator.uncertainty_reason: IGAC gives no horizontal accuracy for this derived parcel reference point.
locator.identity_review: Ilkari identifies its Tocancipá facility and the Faoba name. TIA records Lot 30 for the original Faoba project. The free-zone operator gives its area as 2,404.14 m², matching the sole IGAC R1 parcel of 2,401–2,405 m² in the relevant horizontal-property subdivision.

additions.distinctness_review: The existing HostDime Nebula project occupies a separate Tocancipá property. HostDime identifies Lot 44K in its company history. The commercial lot register gives Block 4 for Lot 44K and Block 6 for Ilkari’s Lot 30.
additions.successor_review: Faoba is the earlier facility name in Ilkari’s own brochure. The operating record covers the existing site; no later expansion design is counted as commissioned.
